// diagnostic

E3514

`meta.rewrite_body` would rewrite `{function}` of package `{package}`, which this build has not allowed

What

`meta.rewrite_body` would rewrite `{function}` of package `{package}`, which this build has not allowed

Why

Rewriting a dependency's code needs the root's consent, one line a reviewer reads

Fix

Add `meta.allow_rewrite(package: "{package}")` after the root's `b.compiler` call

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3514: tests/ui/rewrite_without_consent/stderr.

Error [jet.RewriteWithoutConsent]: `meta.rewrite_body` would rewrite `hello` of package `greet`, which this build has not allowed
  --> tests/ui/rewrite_without_consent/run.jet:9:10
    |
  9 |     meta.rewrite_body(greet.hello, #code {
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Rewriting a dependency's code needs the root's consent, one line a reviewer reads
 Fix: Add `meta.allow_rewrite(package: "greet")` after the root's `b.compiler` call
